description: Film and photography looks and techniques

cinematic.name: Cinematic
cinematic.prompt: cinematic film still {prompt} . shallow depth of field, vignette, highly detailed, high budget, bokeh, cinemascope, moody, epic, gorgeous, film grain, grainy
cinematic.negative: anime, cartoon, graphic, text, painting, crayon, graphite, abstract, glitch, deformed, mutated, ugly, disfigured

film_noir.name: Film Noir B&W
film_noir.prompt: (b&w, Monochromatic, Film Photography:1.3), photorealistic {prompt} . film noir, analog style, soft lighting, realistic, heavy shadow, masterpiece, best quality, golden ratio, intricate, high detail, soft focus, 1940s cinematography, dramatic shadows
film_noir.negative: anime, cartoon, colorful, vibrant, low contrast, bright

polaroid.name: Faded Polaroid
polaroid.prompt: faded polaroid photo {prompt} . analog, old faded photo, old polaroid, vintage colors, instant film, white border, nostalgic
polaroid.negative: ugly, deformed, noisy, blurry, low contrast, vibrant, colorful, digital, sharp

hdr.name: HDR Photo
hdr.prompt: HDR photo of {prompt} . high dynamic range, vivid, rich details, clear shadows and highlights, realistic, intense, enhanced contrast, highly detailed
hdr.negative: flat, low contrast, oversaturated, underexposed, overexposed, blurred, noisy, painting

long_exposure.name: Long Exposure
long_exposure.prompt: long exposure photo of {prompt} . blurred motion, streaks of light, surreal, dreamy, ghosting effect, highly detailed, smooth water, light trails
long_exposure.negative: static, noisy, deformed, shaky, abrupt, flat, low contrast

portrait.name: Portrait Photography
portrait.prompt: RAW candid cinema portrait {prompt} . 16mm, color graded portra 400 film, remarkable color, ultra realistic, textured skin, remarkable detailed pupils, realistic dull skin noise, visible skin detail, skin fuzz, dry skin, shot with cinematic camera
portrait.negative: anime, cartoon, painting, illustration, deformed, ugly, disfigured

neon_noir.name: Neon Noir
neon_noir.prompt: neon noir {prompt} . cyberpunk, dark, rainy streets, neon signs, high contrast, low light, vibrant, highly detailed, moody atmosphere
neon_noir.negative: bright, sunny, daytime, low contrast, black and white, sketch, watercolor, ugly, deformed

tilt_shift.name: Tilt Shift
tilt_shift.prompt: tilt-shift photo of {prompt} . selective focus, miniature effect, blurred background, highly detailed, vibrant, perspective control, toy-like appearance
tilt_shift.negative: blurry, noisy, deformed, flat, low contrast, unrealistic, oversaturated, underexposed
